title: Jamaican Spice Bun Recipe
hookLine: Jamaican-inspired jamaican spice bun recipe with 16 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Soak the craisins, raisins, and cherries in the 1 cup of beer. Set aside and allow to soak for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit. Grease an 8x4 loaf pan. Set aside. Incorporate {m53348_1}, {m53348_2}, {m53348_3}, and {m53348_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure all purpose flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Combine all-purpose flour, baking powder, ground cinnamon, salt, in a large bowl and set aside. In another bowl, combine brown sugar, egg, milk, honey, melted butter, molasses, browning, vanilla extract, and the beer that’s soaking the fruit. Do not pour the fruit in at this time, just the beer. Mix to combine. Incorporate {m53348_5}, {m53348_6}, {m53348_7}, {m53348_8}, {m53348_9}, {m53348_10}, {m53348_11}, {m53348_12}, {m53348_13}, {m53348_14}, {m53348_15}, and {m53348_16} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove 2 tablespoon of flour from the flour mixture and toss the fruit in it. Set aside. Make a well in the middle of the bowl of dry ingredients and pour in wet mixture, stirring until fully combined. And the fruits to the mixture and stir until incpororated.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour mixture into prepared loaf pan and bake in the preheated oven for 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes in the pan and then move to a cooling rack to finish cooling. Serve with slices of cheddar cheese.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
